hero.headline: Simplify your condominium management

cta.heading: Ready to modernize your management?
cta.description: Join the syndics who have chosen a simple, secure and efficient solution.

howItWorks.heading: Three simple steps
howItWorks.step1Description: Register your building, add apartments and configure your syndic settings in minutes.
howItWorks.step2Description: Create accounts — they automatically receive an email with access credentials to their personal portal.
howItWorks.step3Description: Issue charges, track payments, organize assemblies and receive instant notifications via Supabase Realtime.

faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.a1: For condominium managers who want to modernize operations and provide a digital portal for co-owners.
faqSection.q2: Do I need to install anything?
faqSection.a2: No. It's a web app accessible from any browser on desktop, tablet, or mobile. No installation required.
faqSection.a3: Yes. Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security, signed JWTs, immutable audit log, and no stored derived financial values.
faqSection.q4: How many co-owners can I manage?
faqSection.a4: There is no hard technical limit. The architecture is stateless and scalable on Vercel + Supabase.
faqSection.a5: Yes. Partial payments are fully supported, and remaining balances are computed in real time via SQL aggregation.
faqSection.a6: Yes. Via Supabase Realtime, with instant updates and no page refresh.
faqSection.a7: Yes. Payment notices are generated as PDFs via @react-pdf/renderer for both syndic and co-owner flows.
